```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 800

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(visNetwork)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "CoMMpass Pipeline DAG Explorer",
  sidebar = sidebar(
    width = 300,
    textInput("filter_text", "Filter targets by name:", ""),
    checkboxInput("targets_only", "Targets only (hide functions)", TRUE),
    sliderInput("level_sep", "Level separation:", 100, 500, 200, step = 50),
    selectInput("layout", "Layout direction:",
      choices = c("Top-Down" = "UD", "Left-Right" = "LR",
                  "Bottom-Up" = "DU", "Right-Left" = "RL"),
      selected = "LR"
    ),
    hr(),
    h6("Color by:"),
    radioButtons("color_by", NULL,
      choices = c("Layer" = "layer", "Runtime (seconds)" = "seconds",
                  "Size (bytes)" = "bytes"),
      selected = "layer"
    ),
    hr(),
    h6("Selection"),
    verbatimTextOutput("selected_info"),
    actionButton("reset_selection", "Reset selection", class = "btn-sm")
  ),
  card(
    full_screen = TRUE,
    card_header("Pipeline DAG"),
    visNetworkOutput("dag", height = "700px")
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Load embedded network data
  network_data <- reactive({
    json_text <- paste(readLines("data/pipeline_network.json"), collapse = "\n")
    fromJSON(json_text, simplifyDataFrame = TRUE)
  })

  # Layer-color mapping
  layer_colors <- c(
    "data-acquisition" = "#4CAF50",
    "data-cleaning" = "#2196F3",
    "cytogenetics" = "#9C27B0",
    "quality-control" = "#FF9800",
    "differential-expression" = "#F44336",
    "survival" = "#00BCD4",
    "pathway" = "#E91E63",
    "eda" = "#8BC34A",
    "storage" = "#795548",
    "api" = "#607D8B",
    "documentation" = "#CDDC39",
    "infrastructure" = "#9E9E9E",
    "other" = "#BDBDBD"
  )

  # Assign layer from target name prefix
  assign_layer <- function(name) {
    patterns <- c(
      "^(raw_rnaseq|clinical_data$|fetch_)" = "data-acquisition",
      "^(clinical_data_clean|expression_data_clean|integrated|filtered|normalized)" = "data-cleaning",
      "^(cyto|fish_)" = "cytogenetics",
      "^(qc_|data_quality)" = "quality-control",
      "^(deseq2|edger|limma|consensus_de)" = "differential-expression",
      "^(survival|cox_|km_)" = "survival",
      "^(gsea|pathway|gene_annot)" = "pathway",
      "^(eda_)" = "eda",
      "^(save_|parquet|duckdb)" = "storage",
      "^(api_|shiny_)" = "api",
      "^(vig_|code_|doc_|readme_|glossary)" = "documentation",
      "^(config|nix_|dag_|pkgctx)" = "infrastructure"
    )
    for (pat in names(patterns)) {
      if (grepl(pat, name)) return(patterns[[pat]])
    }
    "other"
  }

  filtered_network <- reactive({
    nd <- network_data()
    nodes <- nd$nodes
    edges <- nd$edges

    # Merge meta if available
    if (!is.null(nd$meta) && nrow(nd$meta) > 0) {
      nodes <- left_join(nodes, nd$meta, by = "name")
    }

    # Assign layers
    nodes$layer <- sapply(nodes$name, assign_layer)

    # Filter by text
    if (nzchar(input$filter_text)) {
      pattern <- tolower(input$filter_text)
      keep <- grepl(pattern, tolower(nodes$name))
      keep_names <- nodes$name[keep]
      # Also keep connected nodes (1 degree)
      connected <- edges$from %in% keep_names | edges$to %in% keep_names
      connected_names <- unique(c(edges$from[connected], edges$to[connected]))
      all_keep <- unique(c(keep_names, connected_names))
      nodes <- nodes[nodes$name %in% all_keep, ]
      edges <- edges[edges$from %in% all_keep & edges$to %in% all_keep, ]
    }

    # Color by selection
    if (input$color_by == "layer") {
      nodes$color <- sapply(nodes$layer, function(l) {
        if (l %in% names(layer_colors)) layer_colors[[l]] else "#BDBDBD"
      })
    } else if (input$color_by == "seconds" && "seconds" %in% names(nodes)) {
      secs <- nodes$seconds
      secs[is.na(secs)] <- 0
      max_s <- max(secs, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (max_s > 0) {
        intensity <- secs / max_s
      } else {
        intensity <- rep(0, length(secs))
      }
      nodes$color <- rgb(intensity, 0.3, 1 - intensity)
    } else if (input$color_by == "bytes" && "bytes" %in% names(nodes)) {
      bytes <- nodes$bytes
      bytes[is.na(bytes)] <- 0
      max_b <- max(bytes, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (max_b > 0) {
        intensity <- bytes / max_b
      } else {
        intensity <- rep(0, length(bytes))
      }
      nodes$color <- rgb(0.3, intensity, 1 - intensity)
    } else {
      nodes$color <- sapply(nodes$layer, function(l) {
        if (l %in% names(layer_colors)) layer_colors[[l]] else "#BDBDBD"
      })
    }

    # Node sizing by bytes if available
    if ("bytes" %in% names(nodes)) {
      b <- nodes$bytes
      b[is.na(b)] <- 0
      nodes$value <- 10 + 30 * (b / max(max(b, na.rm = TRUE), 1))
    } else {
      nodes$value <- 20
    }

    # Format for visNetwork
    nodes$id <- nodes$name
    nodes$label <- nodes$name
    nodes$title <- paste0(
      "<b>", nodes$name, "</b><br>",
      "Layer: ", nodes$layer,
      if ("seconds" %in% names(nodes)) paste0("<br>Runtime: ", round(nodes$seconds, 2), "s") else "",
      if ("bytes" %in% names(nodes)) paste0("<br>Size: ", format(nodes$bytes, big.mark = ","), " bytes") else ""
    )

    list(nodes = nodes, edges = edges)
  })

  output$dag <- renderVisNetwork({
    fn <- filtered_network()
    visNetwork(fn$nodes, fn$edges) |>
      visEdges(arrows = "to", smooth = list(type = "cubicBezier")) |>
      visHierarchicalLayout(
        direction = input$layout,
        levelSeparation = input$level_sep,
        sortMethod = "directed"
      ) |>
      visOptions(
        highlightNearest = list(enabled = TRUE, degree = 2, hover = TRUE),
        nodesIdSelection = TRUE
      ) |>
      visInteraction(navigationButtons = TRUE, zoomView = TRUE) |>
      visPhysics(enabled = FALSE) |>
      visEvents(select = "function(nodes) {
        Shiny.setInputValue('selected_node', nodes.nodes[0]);
      }")
  })

  output$selected_info <- renderText({
    sel <- input$selected_node
    if (is.null(sel) || sel == "") return("Click a node to see details")
    fn <- filtered_network()
    node <- fn$nodes[fn$nodes$id == sel, ]
    if (nrow(node) == 0) return("Node not found")
    upstream <- fn$edges$from[fn$edges$to == sel]
    downstream <- fn$edges$to[fn$edges$from == sel]
    paste0(
      "Target: ", sel, "\n",
      "Layer: ", node$layer, "\n",
      if ("seconds" %in% names(node)) paste0("Runtime: ", round(node$seconds, 2), "s\n") else "",
      if ("bytes" %in% names(node)) paste0("Size: ", format(node$bytes, big.mark = ","), " bytes\n") else "",
      "Upstream (", length(upstream), "): ", paste(upstream, collapse = ", "), "\n",
      "Downstream (", length(downstream), "): ", paste(downstream, collapse = ", ")
    )
  })

  observeEvent(input$reset_selection, {
    visNetworkProxy("dag") |> visUnselectAll()
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
